title: Chapter 158
text:
This attack made Han Xiao look like he was in a sorry state. With the Magnetically-Controlled Retractable Armor, it only dealt around fifty damage. His HP was close to three thousand, and he was considered very tanky among Mechanics of the same level. Liu Cheng's kinetic attack was not very strong, but it could easily cause a knockback effect, which was the more annoying part.

The continuous damage from the poison gas appeared on the interface. The Hayme bullet was effective, but Liu Cheng's HP and resistance were not low. He could also use kinetic energy to quickly escape the area covered by the poison gas, so it was not realistic to rely on the poison gas to deal with Liu Cheng. The effect of high-explosive bullets was better, but like the Hayme bullet, it was not the key to victory. Han Xiao did not bring any supplies, so he only had three clips of high-explosive bullets.

He took a deep breath and increased the oxygen level of his blood. He exerted force in his legs and stopped his body from retreating. He put away his pistols and put his hands in front of his body to block Liu Cheng's iron fist. The energy gathered in the fist almost smashed through Han Xiao's block.

Liu Cheng's kinetic energy could increase his strength, and Han Xiao was at a disadvantage in terms of strength.

A shell exploded not far away, and a strong light shone. The two's arms were intertwined, and the posture of one attacking and one defending was like a silhouette painting.

Liu Cheng roared and smashed his fist on Han Xiao's head. The explosive kinetic energy shook the air, and Han Xiao's head tilted. He grabbed onto Liu Cheng's shoulder to prevent himself from being blown away. His other hand activated the thermo-electric incisor gloves and tried to gouge out Liu Cheng's eyeballs.

"Thermo-Electric?" Liu Cheng was alerted and hurriedly looked up. The gloves brushed past his cheek, leaving a burn. The burning sensation pierced his nerves. At the last moment, Liu Cheng unleashed the kinetic energy in his body, and a huge force pushed Han Xiao away.

Han Xiao took a deep breath and wiped off the dirt on his face. Firearms were useless, and he had lost one of his trump cards. It would only allow the enemy to absorb more kinetic energy. However, he still had other machines that could cause damage, such as flames and poison gas.

"Luckily, he's not an energy absorber. Otherwise, I wouldn't be able to do much to him."

Liu Cheng covered the burn on his face and looked at Han Xiao's gloves with fear. He then turned around and ran.

Han Xiao stared blankly for a moment before his expression suddenly changed. He hurriedly chased after him.

On one of the tanks, the soldier operating the machine gun saw a figure rapidly approaching. He subconsciously turned the muzzle of the gun, and all the bullets hit the target. However, he was shocked to find that the target, who should have been shot into a sieve, was actually unscathed. The bullets clanged and clanged all over the ground!

"Don't hit him!" Han Xiao shouted.

However, the warning came too late. The surrounding tanks focused their fire on Liu Cheng, and all the kinetic energy was absorbed. Liu Cheng's eyes were bloodshot, and the accumulated kinetic energy was almost overflowing. His muscles bulged like a rat, and he turned around and took a step forward, creating a huge crater on the ground. His entire body shot out like a cannonball.

This was the kinetic energy of over a thousand bullets!

"Sprinting in a straight line is too fast!" Han Xiao's vision blurred, and he did not have time to dodge. It was as if he had hit a moving train. The scenery in his vision quickly receded, and he flew dozens of meters away like a baseball that had been hit by a home run. He fell to the ground and bounced up several times, creating gullies along the way. His body was covered in mud, and he finally stopped after knocking over a tank.

His head was dizzy, and his whole body was in pain.

Magnetically-Controlled Retractable Armor Durability decreased by 132 points!

You have received 241 damage!

The enemy knew how to use the advantage of his Esper Ability. It was equivalent to borrowing arrows from a straw boat, and in turn, he had suffered a small loss.

"Liu Cheng … I have never heard of his name in my previous life. To think that he is so difficult to deal with. I can't underestimate anyone …" Han Xiao's eyes were like ice as he entered battle mode. He spat out a mouthful of blood and jumped up to tangle with Liu Cheng again.

The two of them fought fiercely on the battlefield. Bullets whistled past their ears, and the flames lit up their field of vision again and again. Everywhere they passed, there was a bullet vacuum. The soldiers did not dare to attack Liu Cheng again, but Liu Cheng could hit the muzzle himself.

"This battlefield is very unfavorable for me."

Han Xiao's eyes flashed. He left Liu Cheng and rushed toward Green Valley Town. Like a flash of a shadow, he dodged the bullets of the Green Valley Town guards. He slid up the wall in a few steps and opened fire with both guns, wantonly killing the guards.

The bullets pierced through the bodies, and blood splattered everywhere.

Liu Cheng was shocked and hurriedly chased after him.

Green Valley Town was the root of the conflict. Han Xiao understood this point and immediately adopted a strategy of avoiding the enemy. He did not want to face Liu Cheng head-on. Unless Liu Cheng did not want the town, he could only be led by the nose. In battle mode, Han Xiao had already come up with a strategy!

After changing the magazine, he shot a few more guards. Suddenly, there was a loud wind behind him. Han Xiao hurriedly turned around and dodged. Liu Cheng brushed past him by a hair's breadth. His punch missed and smashed a large part of the wall. Broken bricks and dust scattered all over the ground.

Liu Cheng's body stagnated, as if he had exhausted all his energy.

"Chance!" Han Xiao's hands reached for Liu Cheng's head. The high temperature of the electro-thermal incisor gloves distorted the air.

However, there was no panic on Liu Cheng's face. Instead, there was a trace of savagery.

"You fell for it!"

The strong energy surged again. There was no sign of exhaustion at all. It was all a disguise. This attack was a killer move that Liu Cheng had been accumulating for a long time. It gathered 80% of his energy and soared into the air. He quickly raised his knee and aimed it at Han Xiao's chin. Once it hit, half of Black Phantom's face would be crushed and fractured.

Han Xiao flew backward out of the wall.

"This touch is not right!" Liu Cheng was shocked. He did not feel like his knee had hit anything.

Han Xiao was already on guard. Just now, in a flash, he had used the push of the electromagnetic hover-boots to retreat. He was only grazed by the knee, and there was almost no damage.

In mid-air, he pulled out the Berserk Eagle and opened fire, shooting at Liu Cheng's eyes.

The accumulated attack missed. Liu Cheng froze for a moment. He could not dodge, but his expression did not change. Bullets were ineffective against his Esper ability.

"Bang!"

The moment it hit his eyes, the bullet lost its energy as usual. However, the warhead suddenly emitted a dazzling light.

Liu Cheng covered his eyes and screamed. His vision was white, and the pain in his eyes affected the balance of his brain.

Dazzling Light Bullet!

It was effective at zero distance. Just thinking about it made him feel good!

He had been accumulating this attack for a long time!

With a grab, Han Xiao used the gap in the wall to climb up the wall again. Taking advantage of Liu Cheng's blindness, he activated [Overload] and [Flaming Will]. His hot hands pressed on Liu Cheng's face. This time, it was a solid hit!

Even though [Flaming Will] was as unlucky as usual, the damage from the first hit was still off the charts!

-423！

Although the damage was not as high as the sniper rifle, the thermo-electric incisor gloves focused on continuous damage. It was already very scary for the instantaneous damage to reach such a level. Liu Cheng was not him. He only had around 2,000 HP, and almost 20% of his HP was burned off in one hit. Furthermore, the damage was still increasing!

The smell of burnt flesh filled the air. Liu Cheng screamed in pain and hurriedly used his energy to push Han Xiao away. His face was severely burned, and it was beyond recognition. It was full of black and red burns.

Liu Cheng's vision was damaged, and his vision was distorted. He could only barely distinguish a direction. He clenched his teeth and ran away.

Han Xiao immediately chased after him. Liu Cheng's heart sank. He was still holding on to the hope that Black Phantom would not chase after him because of the battle. Now, it seemed that there was no hope for him to escape. He knew that he would not be able to escape death. In the end, he fulfilled the responsibility of a bodyguard and delayed Han Xiao. If he died, Overmera would take care of his family.
